entities.name: Query RlmN enzyme
observations: 411 aa protein with RlmN_N domain at residues 2–61 and Radical_SAM domain at residues 201–322.
Has 42–49% identity and approximately 89–94% query coverage to reviewed RlmN homologs.
Predicted to be a dual-specificity radical-SAM RNA methyltransferase; exact substrate specificity is homology-supported rather than directly experimentally established for this sequence.

entities.name: RlmN
observations: EC 2.1.1.192; dual-specificity RNA methyltransferase that methylates A2503 of 23S rRNA and A37 of tRNA.
Binds one [4Fe-4S] cluster coordinated by three cysteines and uses S-adenosyl-L-methionine (SAM).

entities.name: RlmN rRNA A2503 methylation
observations: 23S rRNA adenosine 2503 + SAM, with radical-SAM electron-transfer chemistry, yields 2-methyladenosine 2503 in 23S rRNA + 5'-deoxyadenosine + L-methionine; the mapped Rhea reaction also includes reduced/oxidized ferredoxin and S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine bookkeeping.
Corresponds to Rhea RHEA:42916 and EC 2.1.1.192.

entities.name: RlmN tRNA A37 methylation
observations: tRNA adenosine 37 + SAM, with radical-SAM electron-transfer chemistry, yields 2-methyladenosine 37 in tRNA + 5'-deoxyadenosine + L-methionine; the mapped Rhea reaction also includes reduced/oxidized ferredoxin and S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine bookkeeping.
Corresponds to Rhea RHEA:43332 and EC 2.1.1.192.
